card.name: Digits and units inside reported statistics
card.fires_on: Digits or unit words inside a number in a statistic, such as a confidence interval, area, median age, or page count. The marked piece is part of the number or its unit, not the text around it.

modes.description: The word pages after a number in a book listing.
